name: What is multi-room remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Multi-room remodeling involves renovating two or more areas of your home simultaneously. This approach can be more efficient than remodeling rooms individually, as it allows for a cohesive design and often streamlines the construction process. It's ideal for homeowners looking to update several spaces, such as a kitchen and an adjoining living area, or multiple bathrooms.
acceptedAnswer.description: Multi-room remodeling renovates two or more home areas at once, offering efficiency and cohesive design.
